name: camera-zoom
what: Sixty-frame zoom sequence keeps distance steps below two percent and anchors the cursor

name: depth-focus
what: Depth-separated panels retain focal contrast and blur away from focus

name: follow-camera
what: Car, bus and person chase camera follow, terrain clearance and release

name: look-budget
what: Reference-town draw calls and triangles stay within measured limits in twelve fixed preset and camera combinations

name: look-gpu
what: Desktop hardware frame time and per-pass GPU cost for four presets and four scenes
why: Requires a real GPU and produces machine-specific timings

name: look-phone
what: 390×844 touch proxy at DPR 3 with 4× and 6× CPU throttling
why: Requires a real GPU and produces machine-specific timings

name: soundtest
what: Settings > Sound on/off and volume (effects, ambience, street sound; the music keeps its own): the audio graph's gains, the street voices asleep when off, remembered after a reload, the phone panel still fits

name: edgetest
what: mouse at a screen edge scrolls the map

name: aotest
what: ambient occlusion leaves open ground alone (no blotches, no stripes)

name: townshots
what: builds a ~250-person river town and screenshots day, night, a junction, a factory

name: treelod
what: distant trees match near ones in brightness, colour and cover (MAP=, VIEWS=)

name: impostortest
what: the distant-tree billboards bake the same on a 3x phone as on a 1x desktop (both views, every species)

name: nightglow
what: at night lights stay lights: no multiplied emissives or glowing dust

name: aacompare
what: MSAA vs TAA, still and panning (error, edge energy, shimmer)

name: restest
what: automatic resolution drops only when it helps, and recovers

name: rescheck
what: render resolution vs the screen, per preset

name: musictest
what: ambient piano renders offline: plays, never clips, stays in key

name: housetown
what: a dense town of every house style: variety, model cost, building batch budget (SHOTS=prefix)

name: vehicletest
what: (no browser) vehicles: all 59 models build inside their kind's size and triangle budget, a 100-car town costs no more draw calls than the old renderer, the paint mix is the real-US mix, wheels turn the right way (forwards, backwards, steering), suspension settles, reverse lamps come on by themselves, the public API and every emergency livery are kept

name: vehiclestats
what: (no browser) per model: triangles at close / near / far, build time, bounding box against the kind's spec; flags over-budget or oversize models

name: lineup
what: every vehicle model at 8 m / 40 m / 150 m, day and night, on the real renderer with no game boot (dev/vehicles.html; BASE_URL= picks old or new code; AZS EL SEEDS BRAKE TURN REV PARKED WET FOV env); contact sheets and index.html in shots/lineup/tag
why: a capture tool, not a pass/fail test

name: carcam
what: real cars on the reference block after the morning rush: one moving, one queued, one at a junction, day and night, any preset (PHONE=1 for the 390x844 3x phone); draw calls and triangles per picture, same camera on old and new code

name: sheet
what: tile captures into one labelled contact sheet (before/after pairs for reports)

name: streetaudio
what: (no WebGL) street sound rendered offline and measured: Doppler pass-bys, engines by vehicle kind, honks only from jams of 3+ cars (never a drive-thru line), sirens that follow the moving vehicle, wet-road hiss, peak level, no audio nodes created while playing; `dev/streetaudio.html` is the audition page, docs/cars-look/audio.md the report

name: streetaudio-game
what: the same street sound wired into the running game (QUALITY=low for the phone pool): voices sit on real cars, sleep when zoomed out, paused or muted; a queue honks and free flow does not

name: streetaudio-figure
what: draws the report's before/after spectrograms
why: draws a figure for a report

name: yellowflash
what: night flashing on Ultra (each case on a freshly opened page): bright yellow pixels that pop on frame to frame (still and panning, moonless/full moon, clear/rain), GL errors, failed shader builds; the old prop-flame flash fails it

name: nightcost
what: where a night frame goes (BASE_URL=; quality default high): every GPU pass timed, the frame with one feature switched off at a time, the same pass table at several window sizes, each scene layer hidden in turn, and an A/B mode that alternates a toggle frame by frame; a measurement, docs/round8/night.md
why: a measurement (where a night frame goes)

name: nightlook
what: median night luma of just the street tree crowns and just dark cars in a fixed close-up, found with a mask pass (BASE_URL= or URLS=before=..,after=.. to compare builds; CASES, SWEEP_TREE, SWEEP_CAR; MIN_TREE / MIN_CAR make it a check)
why: a measurement (MIN_TREE / MIN_CAR make it a check)

name: nightwarmth
what: how warm the night lights are: colour temperature of the practical light on the lookbook cameras (OUT=dir saves JPEGs; MAX_CCT=K makes it a check)
why: a measurement (MAX_CCT=K makes it a check)

name: junctionmesh
what: (no browser) the real road meshes: empty spots, down-facing triangles, what the road renderer submits

name: junctionplan
what: top-down PNG of a drawn junction from the real meshes

name: junctionshots
what: before/after junction close-ups, day and night (reference block plus tee, skew and one-way junctions)

name: towers
what: tower-facade luma on the reference block (mean, std-dev, share under luma 20/40, percentiles) at noon and night; PHONE=1, OUT=dir saves JPEGs; BASE_URL for old vs new

name: towerlab
what: the showcase lineup (every zone x level) beside the block, swept over glass / wall-fill settings (SETS=), class-masked luma per shot

name: lowperf
what: frame time of two builds side by side (A_URL old, B_URL new) on the reference block, plus draw calls and triangles
why: a measurement (two builds side by side)

name: peoplelineup
what: every citizen archetype on the no-game lineup page (/dev/people.html) at 8/30/100 m day and night, walk/run/idle/action sheets, `lod` (near/far switch sheet), `feet` (GPU foot probe: planted feet, OK/FAIL) and `bench` (crowd cost); env BASE_URL, OUT, JPEG=1, W/H, BREAKDOWN=1 Also `lists` (the draw-list check, OK/FAIL) and `crowd60`/`crowd24` (40 people as the game camera sees them); env PRESET, PRESETS, N, SCENE, and BASES=old=url,base=url#q=low&near=..,new=url to compare builds in alternation in one browser
why: a capture tool (its `feet` mode is a check, run on purpose)

name: peoplestats
what: (no browser) people model vertices and triangles per level of detail and per archetype (--all); run it in the old tree to compare

name: peoplecost
what: draw calls, triangles and ms of the people group in the reference block, close and at play height (VIEWS=close,street, ROUNDS, FRAMES, SHOT=prefix); BASES=old=url,base=url,new=url compares builds in one browser on the same crowd and camera, SEED, JSON=file, `low [phone|desktop]`

name: walklineshots
what: pictures of the reference block's sharp-cornered junctions from above, zebras and (red) where people walked, for before/after pairs (TAG, OUT, SEED; nodes)

name: bubblefov
what: need bubbles at a wide field of view: one bubble drawn alone and read back on the phone, at 35, 50, 75 and 110°: it keeps its 50° size on the screen, and a tap picks it as far from its middle (SEED)

name: civictest
what: Civic Foundry pack streams in: street trees, furniture, bus shelters; instanced LODs; Low skips it

name: reflecttest
what: water mirror pass: first look at water compiles no shader variants (was 12.9 s on the software GPU), image matches the old clipping, nothing under the surface shows

name: nighttest
what: night exposure targets on the reference block: road median >= 50, pools p90 >= 100, lit facades clear of the ground, < 1% blown out, pools off by day

name: presetlight
what: the presets light the same street alike (noon, dusk, moonless night on the reference block): mean luma within 0.03 of High on every camera and hour

name: lookbook
what: fixed-camera captures of the reference block (noon, dusk, moonless, full moon, rain) per quality, with a contact sheet (docs/ART_DIRECTION.md)

name: vaulttest
what: Asset Vault: pack streams in; zoned lots grow vault buildings that fit; merch lots kept; attractions; services' vault looks + toggle; road furniture; no pack = no change

name: roadgrade
what: a road across a dip stands on an embankment, not a floating slab

name: audiotest
what: ambience loops have no seam thump and no steady beat (no "train chugging")

name: bldshots
what: neighbourhood-zoom shots of homes, shops, apartments, offices, factories, day and night (CLOSE=1 adds close-ups)

name: assets-check
what: Civic Foundry: every generated model, map and reference in the asset library is valid

name: vault-check
what: Asset Vault: all 4,000 models and 12,000 scenes are valid

name: bankfind
what: library: the in-page waterline and bank finder shared by shoreshots.mjs and shoretest.mjs

name: blankwalls
what: commercial buildings: the largest unbroken blank wall plane per size class, compared old build against new
note: only gates with BW_BASE=<json from an old-code run>; BW_OUT=<file> saves a run

name: civic-pack
what: build step: packs Civic Foundry street furniture, service equipment and street trees into public/civic/pack.json + pack.bin

name: communeLeaveQa
what: a commune that leaves: renders its burnt remains and prints the state, attachment and ground paint
note: ignores BASE_URL (PORT env); asks for the real GPU (d3d11)

name: communeQa
what: communes from fixed cameras at several distances, per map, in day, night, rain and snow

name: drawcalls
what: draw calls, triangles, geometries and textures on the reference block from four fixed cameras, per quality preset

name: encodeart
what: encodes a key-art screenshot to WebP with an optional colour grade, using Chromium's encoder

name: frametime
what: average frame ms, draw calls and triangles for one view after optional setup JS

name: gfxshots
what: before/after captures of the reference block from saved cameras at day, night, dusk, moon or rain
note: first run finds cameras and writes shots/gfx/cams.json

name: groundnoise
what: ground texture grain at four camera distances on the reference block, so far ground stays calm, compared old against new
note: needs shots/gfx/cams.json with a lotedge camera (run gfxshots lotedge first); only gates with GN_BASE

name: keyart
what: key art: grows a showcase town at ultra quality and shoots cinematic angles to shots/keyart

name: labshots
what: fixed-camera captures of single building models in the dev lab (dev/buildings.html) for before/after comparison
note: needs the dev server or a snapshot (dev/buildings.html is not in the built game)

name: roadclass
what: pixel count and luma percentiles of each road mesh class at the nighttest camera, to compare builds mesh by mesh

name: roadjunction
what: road junctions: curb returns have a real corner radius, no holes in the asphalt, and zebra and junction triangles face up

name: roadsection
what: road cross-section: a real curb step beside the asphalt, the verge banks down gently, and driveway curbs ramp to the road

name: roadwear
what: road texture wear: patchiness along the road, mean tone, gutter grime and junction tile, compared old build against new
note: only gates with WEAR_BASE or --compare old.json new.json

name: shoreshots
what: fixed-camera captures of a gentle bank's waterline from low, mid and top views

name: shoretest
what: shorelines: the water shader's depth read at the waterline is near zero, and gentle banks get reeds or stones along them

name: silhouette
what: city service models: skyline steps and fill from front and side, compared old build against new
note: only gates with SIL_BASE from an old-code run

name: streetQa
what: a signalised street junction at day and night, with road, node and signal counts printed
note: ignores BASE_URL (PORT env); asks for the real GPU (d3d11)

name: treevariety
what: trees: simulation set unchanged, look-alike neighbours, spacing, groves and riparian share, compared old build against new
note: only gates with TV_BASE from an old-code run

name: vault-pack
what: build step: packs the Asset Vault's models into public/vault/pack.json + pack.bin and writes src/vault/families.ts
